newsitem.title: USA: Pete's Brewing Co Q1 shr loss $0.26.
newsitem.headline: Pete's Brewing Co Q1 shr loss $0.26.

text.p: Pete's Brewing Co on Wednesday said it will report a loss of $0.26 a share for the first quarter ending March 31 versus a profit of $0.04 per share one year ago.
In a statement, Pete's said first quarter expectations called for the company to report a loss of $0.11 per share. It expects to report full quarterly earnings on Monday, April 28.
Pete's cited falling March depletions, declining wholesale inventories and one-time charges as leading to the loss.

The company said one time charges in the first quarter will total $0.10 a share. Charges include $713,000 of development costs for canceled construction of a California brewery and additional expenses for marketing design work.

"While the first quarter loss is greater than we expected, our actions to reduce wholesale inventories reiterate Pete's ongoing commitment to align the supply chain according to current market demand," said Jeff Atkins, acting chief operating officer.
First quarter shipments totaled 75,300 barrels, a 14.0 percent decrease from first quarter 1996.
